## Can’t Log In to My ThemeGrill Account

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/cant-log-in-to-my-themegrill-account/>

If you’re having trouble logging in to your ThemeGrill Account, check if you’re in any of the following cases and follow the instruction to get access your account.

**Never Received Your Password or Forgot Your Password:**

For some reason, if you do not have or know your account password, follow these steps:

- Go to the Freemius Password Recovery Page for Your ThemeGrill Account .

- Enter an email address of your ThemeGrill Account and click the button.

- You should get an email with a password reset link. Click the `Reset your Password` button. It’ll redirect you to a new page to enter a new password.

- On the new page, enter the new password you want to change it to and click `Save Password` button

You can see the steps in the screenshots below:

Step 1: Send Reset Password Email

Step 2: Email with Reset Password Link

Step 3: Enter a New Password to Reset

**Didn’t Receive Account Log In Link After the Purchase**

If you’ve not received an email after the purchase, you can contact us via ThemeGrill Site Chat Support or create a Support Ticket here: https://themegrill.com/support-ticket/

Please provide the purchase email address and theme/plan you purchased. We’ll check your account and help you out as needed.

## How to find the invoice of the purchased theme?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/how-to-find-the-invoice-of-the-purchased-theme/>

When you purchase a theme or product from ThemeGrill, an invoice is automatically generated for your order. This guide walks you through how to locate and access that invoice directly from your ThemeGrill account.

### **Steps to Find Your Invoice**

#### **Step 1: Log In to Your ThemeGrill Account**

Visit the ThemeGrill account login page: https://themegrill.com/account/ . On the login page, enter the following:

- The **email address** used when purchasing the theme.

- Your **account password**. Then, click the **Login** button to proceed.

**Tip:** Forgot your password? Click the **Lost your password?** link on the login page to reset it using your registered email.

#### **Step 2: Navigate to Invoices**

Once you are logged in, you will be taken to your account dashboard. From there:

- Look for the **Invoices** section in the account menu navigation.

- Click on **Invoices** to open the billing history page.

- Here you will find a list of all invoices for your purchased themes and products.

#### Step 3: Locate and Download Your Invoice

From the Invoices page:

- Find the specific purchase for which you need the invoice.

- Click **View Invoice** next to the relevant purchase.

- The invoice will open in a new tab. To save a copy, click **Download PDF**, or click **Print** to print it directly.

## GDPR Compliance and Google Fonts

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/gdpr-compliance-and-google-fonts/>

GDPR (General Data Protection Regulation) Compliance and Google Fonts are different terms but closely related. The GDPR is a European Union regulation for data protection and privacy in the EU and European Economic Area.

GDPR compliance while using the Google Font API is a hot topic worldwide, with various websites being fined with penalties. Explaining the scenario, Google Font is a web font service provided by Google. The Google Font collects the request from the user, fetches the file from its server, and delivers it to the user to produce the fonts. While doing the process, the Google server needs the user’s IP address to deliver the file.

The user’s IP address is personal information that helps identify the user. Sharing such private details of the user without their concern with the third-party services leads to violating the GDPR laws. Thus, Google Fonts violates GDPR.

## How to Use the Google Font While being the GDPR Compliant?

Although being GDPR compliant, you can use the Google Font along with the Spacious theme. With the release of the Spacious Pro version 2.5.9. we have released the option to load the Google font locally rather than from the server. Here are a few steps to follow:

- Navigate to **WordPress Dashboard > Appearance > Customize.**

- Click on **Global > Typography. From the option available,** choose the Google font for your **Base** and **Heading** section of the site.

- Once done, return and navigate to **Additional > Optimization**.

- Enable the option to **Load the Google fonts locally**.

Following the steps above, your font is now loaded locally and not from the Google server. This will help the site visitors eliminate the need to give their site IP address to Google. And **Yes**, it is possible to use the Google font without violating the GDPR.

## Can We Import Demo in Our Existing Website?

<https://docs.themegrill.com/spacious/docs/can-we-import-demo-in-our-existing-website/>

You can import the demo in your existing website but it is not recommended. Importing the demo in your website does not delete your content. It just adds the new contents, settings and the design which you have created previously might not be the same after the demo is imported. Therefore, we highly recommend you to import the demo on a fresh WordPress install rather than importing on the existing website.
